title: Blue Armored Cat Girl
description: Four sequential action poses of a female character with short silver hair, wearing a form-fitting blue armored suit with spiked shoulder pads, a long blue tail, and matching boots. She is depicted leaping and fighting against a solid bright pink background in a comic book style.
prompt: A silver-haired female warrior with a long blue tail wearing a tight blue armored bodysuit with spiked pauldrons and matching boots, shown in four distinct dynamic action poses leaping and fighting. She has glowing purple energy effects around her hands in one pose. Solid vibrant pink background, strong comic book illustration style with sharp lines and cel-shaded rendering.
